queues.name: teq.ingress
queues.description: Raw inbound events and their envelopes, persisted before the platform is acknowledged. The 30-day dedupe window on source:event_id is the completion tombstone that rejects late redeliveries across restarts.

queues.name: teq.lane.interactive
queues.description: Turns from direct messages, mentions and web chat. Grouped by conversation: one turn in flight per conversation.

queues.name: teq.lane.actionable
queues.description: Turns the agent should act on, not urgently. Grouped by conversation.

queues.name: teq.lane.digest
queues.description: Digest turns: overflow and backlog folded into one turn the host summarizes.

queues.name: teq.dead
queues.description: Work that failed every delivery attempt, parked for ListDead and Redrive. Nothing consumes it automatically.
